data.title: Adopt a CRDT for concurrent editing
data.context: Needed a merge strategy for concurrent edits.
data.consequences: Simple, but drops concurrent edits to the same field.

data.title: Adopt an RGA-based CRDT for sync-core
data.context: LWW dropped concurrent edits; users noticed lost characters.
data.decision: Adopt a Replicated Growable Array (RGA) sequence CRDT backed by the automerge-rs library.
data.consequences: Character-level convergence; adds a tombstone-gc dependency on the upstream library.

data.title: Enforce tenant isolation at the storage layer
data.context: App-layer tenant checks were bypassable and hard to audit.
data.decision: Push tenant_id filtering into the storage query layer so no read can omit it.
data.consequences: One choke point to audit; requires backfilling tenant_id on legacy docs.

data.title: Do not build a custom write-ahead log
data.context: A proposal suggested a bespoke WAL for durability.
data.decision: Forbid custom WALs; rely on the storage engine's durability primitives.
data.consequences: Less code to own; must respect the engine's fsync semantics.

data.title: Add backpressure to presence fan-out
data.context: A presence regression leaked memory under load in prod.
data.decision: Bound presence queues and shed load past a per-room threshold.
data.consequences: Bounded memory; presence updates may be coalesced under extreme load.

data.title: Use Stripe metered billing for usage v2
data.context: Evaluating billing providers for usage-based pricing.
data.decision: Use Stripe usage records for metered billing.
data.consequences: Fast to ship; couples billing to Stripe's usage-record API.

data.statement: Concurrent edits to a document converge to a single state on all replicas.
No document data crosses a tenant boundary.
Each document has at most one authoritative writer at any instant.
Redelivering a webhook produces no additional side effects.
Respect the storage engine's transactional guarantees; do not reimplement them.
data.rationale: Reinventing durability/consistency is where subtle data-loss bugs live.

data.statement: Do not build a custom write-ahead log.
data.rationale: The storage engine already provides durable, ordered writes.
data.correctAlternative: Use the storage engine's durability primitives.

data.statement: Never build queries by string concatenation.
data.rationale: String-built queries are an injection and correctness hazard.
data.correctAlternative: Use parameterized queries / the typed query builder.

data.title: Split-brain writer under network partition
data.currentBehavior: Under a partition, two replicas can each believe they are the authoritative writer.
data.targetBehavior: A partitioned replica steps down to read-only until it can re-establish a single writer.

data.title: Presence fan-out is O(n^2) in room size
data.currentBehavior: Every presence update is broadcast to every peer directly.
data.targetBehavior: Presence updates fan out through a tree in O(n log n).

data.residualWorkaround: Run a manual tombstone gc pass nightly.

data.statement: automerge-rs reclaims tombstones within one gc cycle.
SlateDB range scans return keys in sorted order.

data.title: Presence service OOM in production
data.summary: After v1.4.0, presence memory grew unbounded because sessions were never evicted on disconnect; api-gateway latency spiked as presence GC-thrashed.

data.title: Presence leak: cache without an eviction path
data.body: A per-room peer-list cache had no eviction on disconnect. Add backpressure and always pair a cache with an eviction path; require an invariant review on perf PRs touching long-lived state.

data.title: automerge-rs gc needs a manual nightly pass at our scale
data.body: Tombstones are not reclaimed within one cycle under our write volume; the nightly manual gc pass is a required workaround until the upstream fix ships.

data.title: Dashboards earlier would have caught the convergence-lag regression
data.body: Observability baseline landed after two lag regressions; instrument the sync path before, not after, shipping a new merge strategy.
Repro'd with a 3-way partition; the merge keeps the highest-actor-id write and drops the rest. We need a step-down.
Replay ordering is done; blocked on the automerge-rs gc fix for the tombstone growth under replay.
This cache never evicts on disconnect — that's the leak. Rolling forward a hotfix.
